title: camellia gnaphalocarpa
intro: Camellia gnaphalocarpa, commonly known as the Taiwanese tea oil camellia, is a plant species belonging to the tea family. It is known for its seed oil, which has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Camellia gnaphalocarpa seed oil include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as squalene, oleic acid, and linoleic acid. The bioactive constituents of Camellia gnaphalocarpa seed oil may also have neuroprotective and anti-cancer properties, although further research is needed to confirm these effects.
